svg.title: MirageMesh
svg.desc: Local workflow · v1 gate pending. A local-first security application with a supervised Go engine, isolated decoys, durable offline event spooling and a browser interface for incident replay and triage. The reference workflow is verified on Ubuntu 24.04 Linux amd64. Other hosts require their own workflow evidence; the complete OSS v1 gate is pending.
